title: AgentsPermissionRule
description: agents.permission-rule@1 (one-system-v2.md §3.2; Gemini CLI and OpenCode): one permission as data. ACTION is a tool (agents.blueprint@1's hands names, e.g. ov:live.chat.post, machine:shell) or a pattern with * ; RESOURCE narrows it (a path glob, a domain, a command prefix); EFFECT is allow, ask or deny. Rules are read in order and the LAST one that matches wins. WHEN says whether the rule holds while a person is present (attended), in scheduled or triggered work nobody watches (unattended: an ask there settles by the run's level, never waits), or both. The floor (money, passwords, deletions, new recipients, posting in a person's name) asks whatever a rule says.

resource.description: A path glob (src/**), a domain (*.example.org), or a command prefix (npm test).
